SELECT f.* FROM files f LEFT JOIN ( SELECT file_id, SUM(view_count) AS total_sum FROM view_records GROUP BY file_id ) v_stat ON f.file_id = v_stat.file_id ORDER BY v_stat.total_sum DESC, f.file_id ASC
LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM files WHERE file_id = #{fileId} LIMIT 1

SELECT f.file_id, f.file_name, f.file_type, f.course_id, f.file_remark, f.upload_user, f.upload_date, f.file_path, MAX(CASE WHEN col.user_id = #{userId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_favorite, MAX(CASE WHEN col.user_id = #{userId} THEN ci.create_at ELSE NULL END) AS favorite_time FROM inver.files f LEFT JOIN inver.collection_items ci ON f.file_id = ci.item_id AND ci.item_type = 'source' LEFT JOIN inver.collections col ON ci.collection_id = col.collection_id WHERE f.course_id = #{courseId} GROUP BY f.file_id, f.file_name, f.file_type, f.course_id, f.file_remark, f.upload_user, f.upload_date, f.file_path ORDER BY f.file_id ASC

choose.when: INSERT INTO files (file_name, file_type, course_id, file_remark, upload_user, upload_date, file_path) VALUES (#{file.fileName}, #{file.type}, #{file.courseId}, #{file.remarks}, #{userId}, NOW(), #{file.filePath})
UPDATE files SET file_name = #{file.fileName}, course_id = #{file.courseId}, file_remark = #{file.remarks}, upload_user = #{userId}, upload_date = NOW() WHERE file_id = #{file.fileId}

mapper.select: SELECT * FROM files WHERE file_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR file_remark LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
